children.value: > Fact From Story: According to him, the boom inflated record prices; now, with the higher fees Discogs is imposing, a sales decline that was almost inevitable post-lockdown has become steeper.

> > Fact From Story: The pandemic had created something of a record sales bubble: people who were already vinyl aficionados were stuck at home with their record players, stimulus checks, and nothing to spend them on besides survival and things you could do at home — like listen to music.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People are more likely to spend money when they have extra money and are bored.
> Commonsense Knowledge: When costs go up and prices are already high, sales are more likely to decline.
